variants.notes: Ricoh 2A03 = NES NTSC main CPU. Customized 6502: decimal mode disabled (D flag exists but is no-op in ALU), integrated APU (separate spec), no BCD ALU. Compatible with full 6502 instruction set including all 105 unofficial opcodes.
PAL variant — same ISA as 2A03, different CPU clock divisor + PPU clock. ISA-level identical; not yet shipped.

isa_metadata.comment: N2.4 — block-JIT policy hints. 6502 spec uses RAW CPU cycles in cycles.form ("3m" means 3 cycles, not 12). cycles_per_spec_unit=1 distinguishes this from GB/ARM's m-cycle×4 convention. Variable 1-3 byte; pc_update_policy=lazy under block-JIT alloca+mem2reg.

general_purpose.comment: 6502 has only 3 user-visible 8-bit GPRs (accumulator + 2 index regs). SP/PC/P are status registers below.

status.name: P
status.comment: Processor status: NV-BDIZC. Bit 5 always 1 (unused). Bit 4 (B) only set on stack pushes from BRK/PHP. D flag exists but Ricoh 2A03 disables decimal mode in ALU.

status.name: SP
status.comment: Stack pointer — logical 8-bit, physical stack lives at $0100..$01FF. Push: write $0100|SP, then SP--. Pull: SP++, then read $0100|SP.

exception_vectors.name: IRQ
exception_vectors.comment: Shared with BRK; B flag distinguishes which one fired.

pipeline.comment: 6502 has no pipeline-PC quirks: PC reads always return the current instruction's address + length. No 'pre-fetched next' visibility.
